article.title: Ranchers are the last holdout against industrial animal agriculture. Is their future at risk?
article.author: Editor
article.content: The seemingly unending dry spell, which has plagued much of the Midwest, is contributing to a historic cattle shortage that is pushing beef prices to record highs. A developing El Niño is currently bringing some relief, but drought persists in parts of the region. The post Ranchers are the last holdout against industrial animal agriculture. Is their future at risk? appeared first on MR Online .
